info.title: Jurexio Platform API
info.description: Auto-generated from Express router stack via scripts/generate-openapi-spec.ts

RequestPhase.description: Lifecycle phase of an AI request (NV-COMPLETION-DRIVEN-001). accepted → grounding → generating → enriching → ready | degraded | failed_infra. ready = complete. degraded = complete, but an optional enrichment (extra chain-of-thought, a hung memory source) was dropped so the request could progress — treat as SUCCESS and render the content. failed_infra = no usable outcome. A client-side abort is NOT a phase: JRX keeps working, so poll rather than mapping the abort to a timeout error.

optionalDegraded.description: True when an optional enrichment was dropped to progress. Content is present and the safety gates ran — a success signal, not an error.

requestId.description: Per-HTTP-call id; also returned in the x-request-id header.

orchestrationId.description: Stable id for a whole multi-leaf Queen run, survives retries. Absent on the specialist path, which is a single call with nothing to correlate.

sessionId.description: Session this turn belongs to. Minted by JRX for NSP/NYM when the caller sends none — echo it on the next turn to continue the same session and reuse its memory.

qualityEnvelope.description: Which mandatory steps ran. `missingMandatory` empty = all gates satisfied; `scaledOptional` lists stages intentionally skipped.

completions.description: Billed provider completions for this request.

200.description: Outcome envelope. `requestPhase` is always present; `ready` and `degraded` are both SUCCESS (`degraded` = answer complete, an optional enrichment was dropped to progress). Only `failed_infra`, or an empty body after the worker deadline, is a failure.
